whenNotToUse: SHA-1 is collision-broken — it is included for legacy checksums only; use SHA-256 or stronger for anything security-related.
Never hash passwords with fast general-purpose hashes like SHA-256 for storage — password storage needs a slow KDF such as bcrypt, scrypt, or Argon2.
